{{CharInfobox| |color={{psychic color}} |corecolor={{psychic color light}} |bordercolor={{fighting color}} |name=Rinto |jname=リント |tmname=Rinto |image=Rinto.png |caption=Rinto |size=250px |trainer=yes |trainerclass=[[Pokémon Trainer]] |game=no |gender=Male |colors=yes |hair=Green |eyes=Brown |anime=yes |epnum=JN051 |epname=Trials of a Budding Master! |enva=Khoi Dao |java=Kohei Amasaki }} '''Rinto''' (Japanese: '''リント''' ''Rinto'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|JN}}. ==In animation== [[File:Ash and Rinto.png|thumb|left|250px|Rinto and Ash]] Rinto first appeared in ''[[JN051|Trials of a Budding Master!]]''. He was first seen at [[Rock Tunnel]], watching the [[World Coronation Series]] {{pkmn|battle}} between {{Ash}} and [[Dozer]]. After seeing {{AP|Farfetch'd}} run off after defeating Dozer's {{p|Gurdurr}}, Rinto spoke to Ash about Farfetch'd's huge potential. He then had a battle against Ash and Farfetch'd using his {{p|Gallade}} and won with just one move. Before he left, Rinto talked about the lack of synchrony between Ash and Farfetch'd and that he would like to battle Ash again when they became more in sync. Rinto reappeared in ''[[JN060|Beyond Chivalry… Aiming to be a Leek Master!]]'', where Ash re-encountered him at the [[Vermilion City]] [[Pokémon Center]] and learned that he was also a World Coronation Series participant. He had only recently entered the competition when they first met and was in the Normal Class at the time, hence why Ash was unable to get an official battle notification back then. Now, however, he was in the Great Class like Ash, meaning they could have an official match. When Ash told Rinto about his and Farfetch'd's [[JN056|training]] with [[Wikstrom]] at the [[Castle of Chivalry]], Rinto revealed that he and Gallade had also trained there in the past. Ash and Rinto chose to conduct their official [[rematch]] with the same Pokémon they used in their previous battle. During the match, Gallade sliced Farfetch'd's leek in two, but Ash improvised by having Farfetch'd mimic Wikstrom's {{p|Aegislash}} and use the remaining part of the leek as a shield. With this strategy, Farfetch'd was able to land several [[critical hit]]s on Gallade and [[Evolution|evolve]] into {{AP|Sirfetch'd}} as a result. Rinto intentionally let Gallade take a hit from Sirfetch'd's {{m|Night Slash}} in order to activate Gallade's [[Ability]], {{a|Justified}}. However, despite the power boost provided by this Ability, Gallade was still defeated. Afterward, Rinto admitted his defeat and that he too still had a lot to learn. ===Character=== Rinto is very observant and analytical, analyzing Ash's Farfetch'd and his battling style. Despite respecting other Trainers, Rinto acted with a certain amount of sarcasm towards Ash in his relationship with his Pokémon, such as ignoring Ash's presence and talking only to his opponent's Farfetch'd. ===Pokémon=== This listing is of Rinto's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: ====On hand==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Rinto |pkmn=Gallade |type1=Psychic |type2=Fighting |img=Rinto Gallade.png |epnum=JN051 |epname=Trials of a Budding Master! |gender=male |vajp=Daisuke Namikawa |vaen=Marc Thompson |desc={{p|Gallade}} is Rinto's only known Pokémon. He first watched the [[World Coronation Series]] battle between {{Ash}} and [[Dozer]]. He then had a battle against {{AP|Farfetch'd}} following its victory over Dozer's {{p|Gurdurr}} and won. Gallade reappeared in a flashback in ''[[JN056|Searching for Chivalry!]]''. Gallade reappeared in ''[[JN060|Beyond Chivalry… Aiming to be a Leek Master!]]''. He was used in a World Coronation Series match against Ash and his Farfetch'd, who ended up evolving mid-battle and defeating Gallade this time around. Gallade's known moves are {{m|False Swipe}}, {{m|Night Slash}}, {{m|Close Combat}}, {{m|Psycho Cut}}, and {{m|Feint}}, and his Ability is {{a|Justified}}.}} ====Traveling with==== {| width="50%" |- | {{ActivePoké|||nick=Rotom Phone|Rinto Rotom Phone.png|electric|ghost|link=Rotom Phone}} | | |} ===Achievements=== Rinto has competed in the following competitions: * [[World Coronation Series]] Rank: Unknown (Normal Class) (''[[JN051|Trials of a Budding Master!]]'') * [[World Coronation Series]] Rank: Unknown (Great Class) (''[[JN060|Beyond Chivalry… Aiming to be a Leek Master!]]'') * [[Castle of Chivalry]] Challenge - Participant (prior to ''[[JN060|Beyond Chivalry… Aiming to be a Leek Master!]]'') ===Voice actors=== {{vatable | color = {{psychic color light}} | bordercolor = {{fighting color dark}} | ja = 天﨑滉平 ''Kōhei Amasaki'' | en = Khoi Dao | ar = جوزيف عقيقي ''Josef Akiki'' | fr_eu = Corentin Burki | it = Davide Fumagalli | pl = Konrad Szymański | pt_br = Filipe Gimenez | es_la = Miguel Ángel Ruiz | es_eu = Miguel Antelo | ca = Sergi Mani }} ==In the manga== [[File:Rinto and Gallade JNM.png|thumb|150px|Rinto in Pokémon Journeys]] ===Pokémon Journeys=== Rinto appeared in ''[[JNM18|Beyond Chivalry… Aiming to Be a Leek Master!]]'', playing the same role as he does in {{aniseries|JN}}. ====Pokémon==== This listing is of Rinto's known Pokémon in the manga: =====On hand===== {| width="96px" | {{ActivePoké|Rinto|Gallade|Rinto Gallade JNM.png|Psychic|Fighting|size=200px|link=no}} ♂ | |} =====Traveling with===== {| width="50%" |- | {{ActivePoké|||nick=Rotom Phone|479Rotom-Phone.png|electric|ghost|size=50px|link=Rotom Phone}} | | |} ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background: #{{psychic color light}}; border: 3px solid #{{fighting color dark}}" !
